columns.phase: j / 32, j = 0 to 31; phase 0 at each upward crossing of cl, phase j by linear interpolation in time within each cycle
columns.cd_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of cd at that phase
columns.cd_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of cd at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next
columns.cl_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of cl at that phase
columns.cl_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of cl at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next
columns.p1_u_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of p1_u at that phase
columns.p1_u_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of p1_u at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next
columns.p1_v_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of p1_v at that phase
columns.p1_v_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of p1_v at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next
columns.p2_u_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of p2_u at that phase
columns.p2_u_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of p2_u at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next
columns.p2_v_mean: mean over the 32 cycles of p2_v at that phase
columns.p2_v_sd: sample standard deviation over the 32 cycles of p2_v at that phase: the spread from one cycle to the next

columns.St: f L / U = k / T, k = 0, 1, ... while St is at most 2, T the length of the window in units of L / U; the line of cl falls on bin 32, that of cd on bin 64
columns.psd_cd: one-sided power spectrum of cd over exactly the window, resampled by linear interpolation to even steps at the native step, mean removed, no taper; normalised so that the sum over all bins up to Nyquist equals the variance of cd over the window, and the rows published sum to the variance below st_max 2
columns.psd_cl: one-sided power spectrum of cl over exactly the window, resampled by linear interpolation to even steps at the native step, mean removed, no taper; normalised so that the sum over all bins up to Nyquist equals the variance of cl over the window, and the rows published sum to the variance below st_max 2
columns.psd_p1_v: one-sided power spectrum of p1_v over exactly the window, resampled by linear interpolation to even steps at the native step, mean removed, no taper; normalised so that the sum over all bins up to Nyquist equals the variance of p1_v over the window, and the rows published sum to the variance below st_max 2
